headline: LP gas companies warn of possible distribution shortfall if maximum price regulation is not updated
summary: Companies grouped in Amexgas warned that distribution could be disrupted unless maximum price regulation is updated. They said the operating margin lag must be addressed.
why: Liquefied petroleum gas is a household energy source, and regulated price caps affect distributor profitability and supply continuity.
original_headline: Empresas de gas LP alertan posible falta de distribución si no se actualiza regulación de precios máximos
